decks.notes: This Dimir control deck focuses on utilizing Yorion as a companion to maximize value through blinking cards like Omen of the Sea and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck aims to control the game with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push while generating card advantage with Stormchaser's Talent and Grim Bauble. By running only one-of unique lands like Otawara, Soaring City and Hive of the Eye Tyrant, the deck can adapt to different situations and playstyles. Overall, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through a combination of control elements and card advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The deck runs a variety of creatures with different converted mana costs to effectively tutor for answers and threats. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion provides additional value and synergizes well with the deck's strategy. With a mix of removal spells, versatile lands, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing powerful creatures and burn spells to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. The key strategy is to maintain board control using cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with Duress and Thoughtseize. The inclusion of cards like Fear of Missing Out and Torch the Tower provide additional reach and removal options. Overall, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm the opponent through a combination of efficient threats and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying low-cost aggressive creatures and buffing them with combat tricks to deal damage to the opponent as swiftly as possible. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creatures like Emberheart Challenger, Monastery Swiftspear, and Heartfire Hero, supported by spells like Infuriate and Reckless Rage. The inclusion of cards like Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provides additional sources of damage to close out the game efficiently. Overall, this deck is built to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain it throughout the game.

This deck focuses on control through the use of Enigmatic Incarnation, utilizing a variety of creatures to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck includes a companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, for additional value. By using powerful creatures like Archon of Emeria and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, along with removal spells like Vanishing Verse and Fatal Push, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The deck also includes a variety of lands and enchantments to support its strategy and provide flexibility in different matchups.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive creature plays combined with burn spells to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. The strategy relies on efficiently using low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary alongside powerful spells like Atarka's Command and Play with Fire to deal damage quickly and efficiently. By applying constant pressure and utilizing the deck's synergy between creatures and spells, the goal is to outpace the opponent and secure a swift victory.

The main idea of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck includes efficient creatures like Emberheart Challenger and Soul-Scar Mage, as well as powerful burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage. The goal is to quickly bring the opponent's life total down while maintaining board control with creatures like Manifold Mouse and Pawpatch Recruit. With a mix of creatures and burn spells, this deck aims to apply pressure and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle using efficient creatures and burn spells. By quickly building a board presence and maximizing damage output, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and finish the game before they can stabilize. With a focus on creatures with low mana costs and powerful abilities, along with a mix of burn spells for removal and additional damage, the deck is designed to consistently apply pressure and force the opponent to react defensively.

This deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent with powerful creatures and removal spells in order to quickly reduce their life total to zero. It utilizes cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, and Blade of the Oni to put pressure on the opponent, while also using cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt their game plan. The deck aims to maintain a fast pace and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize or mount a defense.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard and dealing damage to the opponent. It includes cheap spells like Lightning Axe, Fiery Impulse, and Treasure Cruise to trigger the Phoenix's ability. The deck also includes card draw and manipulation spells like Consider, Sleight of Hand, and Opt to help find key cards like Arclight Phoenix and Temporal Trespass. The inclusion of Picklock Prankster and Brazen Borrower helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining pressure on the board.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. By combining efficient removal like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize with powerful threats such as Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester, it aims to control the board and put pressure on the opponent's life total. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells, with options for both black and red mana sources. Overall, the deck's strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently dealing damage to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively build up devotion to green through powerful green creatures and mana acceleration. By utilizing cards like Leyline of the Guildpact and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, the deck aims to quickly ramp up mana and cast big threats like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps generate card advantage and mana, while Storm the Festival and Invasion of Ixalan provide additional creature support. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with green creatures and powerful spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption to control the board while quickly closing out the game. It utilizes cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's creatures and hand, while also using efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply early pressure. The deck also includes burn spells like Torch the Tower and Go for the Throat to deal direct damage to the opponent, along with utility lands like Mutavault and Blazemire Verge for additional advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing an aggressive board presence using creatures like Overlord of the Mistmoors, Skyclave Apparition, and Steel Seraph, supported by mana acceleration from Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic. Leyline Binding and Flicker of Fate provide control elements, while Get Lost disrupts opponent's strategies. The land base includes dual lands for color fixing and utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures for protection and Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire for creature resilience. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient creatures and disrupt their game plan to secure victory.

The main idea of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Aven Interrupter and Skyclave Apparition. Using cards like Collected Company to deploy multiple threats at once and maintaining a steady mana base with Llanowar Elves and other mana dorks, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize. This deck focuses on aggressive plays and tempo advantage to secure victories in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Enigmatic Incarnation enchantment to control the board and tutor for powerful creatures. The deck includes a variety of lands to support the mana base and ensure consistency. The companion, Yorion, Sky Nomad, provides additional value by flickering permanents. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Fatal Push, while assembling a powerful board presence with high-impact creatures like Archon of Emeria and Atraxa, Grand Unifier.
